questions.question: What is the time complexity of this code?
questions.explanation: This code iterates through the array exactly once to find the maximum value. Since we examine each element once, the time complexity is O(n), where n is the length of the array.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of this code?
questions.explanation: The function iterates through the entire array once, checking each element. This is a linear scan, resulting in O(n) time complexity.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of this code?
questions.explanation: The loop runs exactly n times (where n is the array length), pushing each element into a new array. Each push operation is O(1), so the total complexity is O(n).

questions.question: What is the time complexity of this code?
questions.explanation: This filtering operation examines each element of the array exactly once. The modulo and array append operations are both O(1), making the overall complexity O(n).

questions.question: What is the time complexity of this code?
questions.explanation: This is a linear search. In the worst case (element not found or at the end), we check all n elements. Even though it may return early, the worst-case time complexity is O(n).
